about: I'm in third year of the five-year BE/ME in Mechanical Engineering at University College Dublin. Most of my time outside lectures goes into UCD Formula Student, where I work on the team's first full chassis redesign and run the workshop.

Before engineering, I spent three and a half years in a bike shop's workshop. Watching parts come back broken taught me that a component nobody can service or trust isn't finished, however light it is. I design with that in mind.
